description:
Discover every Firestore root collection in the project that is not yet mapped to a collection, infer a collection schema for each (display names and widgets picked by an LLM), and save them all. Requires admin.

Covers every database of the project. Collections that already exist are left alone, so it is safe to run again later to pick up new Firestore collections. Can take a while on large projects.
name: setup_all_collections
title: Set up all collections
